These messages are entirely fabricated test data. No body, identity, credential,
message ID, link token, or timestamp was copied from Gmail. `TEST-*`, Synthetic
Student, and Synthetic School are deliberately fake privacy probes.

`families.json` contains readable source statements for the A–G lifecycle corpus.
The tests construct deterministic advisory provider responses separately, then
exercise the normal parser, sanitizer, host validator, retained evidence,
candidate review, planner, and public-payload validator. Every transport remains
mocked and auto-send remains false.
